question: The average of two numbers is M. If one number is N, then the other number is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Sum** of observations = **Average** × **Number of observations**.

Total sum of **two numbers** = M × 2 = 2M.

Other number = **Total Sum** − **First Number** = 2M − N.

**∴ The correct answer is 2M-N.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3219ab4e13ea2820650b154db49b3fbaf150f331bb323383e79cca1212f1cd51.png] 

**Given:**

**Average** of two numbers = M

One number = N

Let the **second number** be x.

**Formula Used:**

Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations)

**Calculations:**

⇒ M = (N + x) ÷ 2

⇒ 2 × M = N + x

⇒ 2M = N + x

⇒ x = 2M − N

**∴ The correct answer is 2M-N.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Definition of Average (Arithmetic Mean)

It is the **central value** of a set of data, calculated by dividing the **total sum** by the **count** of values.

Sum Calculation

The **sum** of n observations is always **n × Average**. This is the base for solving missing number problems.

Weighted Average

When two groups with averages A₁ and A₂ and sizes n₁ and n₂ are combined, the new average is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).</p
